run_generate_profile_shell_scripts: run the script to generate Nsight Systems profiling shell scripts for Habitat-lab DDPPO training
generate_slurm_profiling_scripts: generate slurm submission and task shell scripts for distributed profiling on a cluster
generate_local_profiling_script: generate a local profiling shell script for single-machine Nsight Systems capture
configure_step_range_capture: configure the script to capture a specific range of training steps instead of a time window
configure_cuda_opengl_capture: configure the script to capture CUDA and OpenGL traces alongside NVTX profiling data
